name: Onna Kenshi Meru no Injoku ~Umitsukerareta Inma no Tamago~
original_name: 女剣士メルの淫辱 ～産み付けられた淫魔の卵～
source:
Mel was a female warrior sworn to protect her princess, Clairisse, who liked to sneak out of the castle and play. During one such excursion both girls were attacked. Mel fought to the end, but finally lost control and succumbed to fate... 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE068673.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
梅尔是一名发誓守护公主克拉丽丝的女战士，而克拉丽丝喜欢偷偷离开城堡玩耍。一次这样的外出中，两个女孩遭到袭击。梅尔战斗到最后，却最终失去控制，屈服于命运……
